_comment: MCP tool definitions for the R&R Brain Gateway. One gateway, one door: Web, WhatsApp, Siri and phone all call POST /brain with one of these tools. Served verbatim at GET /brain/tools. Unknown argument keys are stripped by the server and never honored — pricing, channel and case state can never be smuggled in.

tools.description: Decode a 17-character VIN into year/make/model/trim via the free NHTSA vPIC API. Read-only. Charges the decode price from gateway/config/pricing.json only on a successful decode; invalid VINs, NHTSA failures and not-found VINs never charge.

vin.description: 17-character VIN (letters A-Z except I, O, Q, plus digits). ISO 3779 check digit enforced.

tools.name: decode_vin

tools.description: Identify the vehicle from a VIN (live NHTSA decode) or from year/make/model, and report whether it is in the verified parts catalog and which categories have verified data. Read-only. Charges the decode price only on success.

make.description: Vehicle make. Required when no VIN is given.

model.description: Vehicle model. Required when no VIN is given.

year.description: Model year (1950 to next year). Required when no VIN is given.

tools.name: get_vehicle

tools.description: Look up verified whole-car parts for a vehicle: glass, exterior, interior, engine, mechanical. Returns part numbers with variant_status (exact, variant_ambiguous, not_found). NEVER guesses a variant: when the exact glass variant depends on unanswered questions (rain sensor, ADAS camera, heads-up display, acoustic, heated), the tool returns 422 variant_ambiguous with follow_up questions and charges nothing. Price and availability are null until supplier feeds exist.

category.description: Which category to look up. Default full (all four whole-car categories plus glass).

glass_type.description: Glass position. Required when category is glass.

location.description: Optional customer location. Adds the location addon price and a distance-to-shop estimate.

make.description: Vehicle make. Required when no VIN is given.

model.description: Vehicle model. Required when no VIN is given.

part.description: Optional NAGS part number to decode (e.g. FW03760 GBY). Returns the NAGS reading plus any catalog cross-check.

variant_answers.description: Answers to previously returned follow_up questions, e.g. {"rain_sensor": true, "adas_camera": false}. Only accepted keys are rain_sensor, adas_camera, heads_up_display, acoustic, heated.

year.description: Model year. Required when no VIN is given.

tools.name: lookup_part
tools.price_tier: decodeGlass for glass, fullVehicle for full, decode otherwise

tools.description: Typical price range for a glass job on a vehicle — a guide, never a final price. R&R texts a firm quote after staff review. Free: this tool never charges. Recalibration range is included when the vehicle may need ADAS recalibration.

make.description: Vehicle make. Required when no VIN is given.

model.description: Vehicle model. Required when no VIN is given.

year.description: Model year. Required when no VIN is given.

tools.name: quote

tools.description: Create a service case through the R&R intake (same contract as POST /api/v1/public/intake in apps/api). The customer initiates it; channel is pinned DIRECT and state REQUEST_RECEIVED by the server, never by the caller. Returns a 201 client-safe confirmation: case reference + intake-status token. Rate limited to 20 per 10 minutes. Photos cannot be sent through the gateway — damage photos go through the web intake. Free: the shop's own intake never charges.

customer_phone.description: 10-digit US mobile number R&R texts the quote link to. Formatting and a leading 1 are fine.

make.description: Vehicle make. Required when no VIN is given.

model.description: Vehicle model. Required when no VIN is given.

note.description: Optional free text, max 1000 characters. What happened to the glass.

service_address.description: Where the car will be serviced. formatted is required; street, city, state, zip, lat, lon, place_id optional.

vin.description: Optional 17-character VIN (ISO 3779 check digit enforced). When given without year/make/model, the intake decodes it.

year.description: Model year (1950 to next year). Required when no VIN is given.

tools.name: create_case

tools.description: Check a case created through the intake, using its intake-status token. Returns the client-safe progress projection only: reference, vehicle, glass type, phase, headline, steps, quote_ready. Never internal state names, ids, or economics. Read-only and free.

status_token.description: The intake-status token returned by create_case.

tools.name: get_case_status

tools.description: STAFF ONLY. Paid MyGrant VIN lookup to order the exact glass for a case: $1 per lookup (see config mygrant.vin_lookup_cost_usd), capped at the daily spend cap. Requires a staff-role API key. The lookup runs only after the spend-cap check, and a failed lookup never charges. In this MVP build the live MyGrant session is not wired, so the tool enforces every gate and then returns 503 mygrant_not_configured with the exact step to wire it — it never pretends an order happened.
tools.name: order_glass
